scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, evidence-backed investigation with node-id citations and file reads; nearly all rubric points hit. Minor deductions for the read-only mechanism attribution (CoW/ReFS vs CAS hardlinks), somewhat scattered fix recommendations mixing root-cause and workaround, and light verification of the proposed fix. The run also hit a timeout, though the report was completed.

rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects set Distrib to same ConfigurationLinterService path
Identified read-only outputs (CAS hard links / CoW) making files unsignable
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so only service project owns folder
Verified the fix would result in each project signing only its own files
